# `aitbc account get`

Fetch on-chain information for a given account address, including balance and nonce.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc account get [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | yes | Account address (0x, 42 hex chars) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID for multichain operations |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc account get --address <address>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc account get --address <address> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
